text: いい　わざ　おしえてやるぜ！

patterns.name: 〜てやる
patterns.explanation: やる after a て-form verb means doing something for someone, said in a rough, talking-down way. おしえてやる = 'I'll teach you'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, cocky male speech that adds push, like 'I tell you'. おしえてやるぜ = 'I'll teach you, all right!'.
